verdicts.reason: A pulls the sneaker off its cream circle and leaves it floating on the left, so the circle becomes a bare orb in the bottom-right. The logo also drifts to an arbitrary near-centre spot beside the badge, although the headline and subcopy at least stay grouped. B keeps the original's left-text, right-product structure, but the shoe now sits on top of the circle instead of inside it. The subcopy is stranded about 150px below the headline in dead space, and the logo is shrunk almost to illegibility. B is the less damaged of the two because its product and circle still read as one unit.
